what_happened.line: The commission treated the 950 Mass Ave certificate-to-alter package as complete pending revisions and moved to hold a public hearing within 45 days.
A motion for the hearing was made and seconded, but the recording does not make the outcome of the vote audible.
The hearing is targeted for the September meeting, tentatively the 12th at 7:30; the 14-day public notice requirement is the limiting factor.
Members debated window color and style and whether color is exempt from the bylaw before treating the application as complete.
Property owner notification, outreach and a guideline modification were listed as not yet done.

why_it_matters: A change to a historic building on Mass Ave moves to a public hearing, which is where neighbors and residents can comment on windows and color before any approval.
Whether color falls outside the bylaw is a question the commission discussed without a recorded resolution in these minutes, so it may recur in other alteration applications.
